title: Ngen language
description: Language of the East Santo languages originating on Espiritu Santo, Vanuatu
extract: Ngen, or Shark Bay, is one of the East Santo languages group of languages. It is spoken on Espiritu Santo in Vanuatu. It has about 450 speakers. It is close geographically and linguistically to the now dormant Lorediakarkar.
